bool FMWNorwayScenarioTranslator::ExecuteIsolatedAtomicCommit(const FMWNorwayControlledAtomicStage& Stage,const FMWNorwayAtomicCommitReadinessCheckpoint& Ready,int32 FailAtIndex,FMWNorwayIsolatedCommitState& State,FMWNorwayIsolatedCommitReport& Report)

if(!Ready.bReadyForIsolatedAtomicCommitTest||Stage.Records.Num()!=62||State.bCommitted){Report.AddFatal(TEXT("isolated_commit_not_authorized"),TEXT("Readiness, coverage, or repeated-commit guard failed."));return false;}

bool FMWNorwayScenarioTranslator::ValidateIsolatedCommitReceiptAndFingerprints(const FMWNorwayControlledAtomicStage& Stage,const FMWNorwayAtomicCommitReadinessCheckpoint& Ready,int32 FailAtIndex,const FString& ProductionFingerprint,const FString& TemporalFingerprint,FMWNorwayIsolatedCommitReceipt& Receipt,FMWNorwayIsolatedCommitFingerprintReport& Report)

if(bCommitted){if(!Report.bBeforeAndAfterDiffer||!Report.bReceiptProducedAfterSuccess||Receipt.OperationCount!=62)Report.AddFatal(TEXT("isolated_fingerprint_success_invalid"),TEXT("Successful commit fingerprint or receipt evidence is invalid."));}

else{if(!Report.bRollbackMatchesBefore||Report.bFailedReceiptCommitted)Report.AddFatal(TEXT("isolated_fingerprint_rollback_invalid"),TEXT("Failed commit did not restore exact before-state or marked receipt committed."));}

bool FMWNorwayScenarioTranslator::BuildIsolatedSaveSnapshot(const FMWNorwayIsolatedCommitState& State,const FMWNorwayIsolatedCommitReceipt& Receipt,bool bAdvancedSave,FMWNorwayIsolatedSaveSnapshot& Snapshot,FMWNorwayIsolatedSaveLoadReport& Report)
if(bAdvancedSave){Report.AddFatal(TEXT("isolated_save_advanced_save_rejected"),TEXT("Opening-state snapshot cannot overwrite an advanced save."));return false;}

if(!State.bCommitted||!Receipt.bCommitted||Receipt.ScenarioId!=TEXT("Scenario.Norway.1062Opening")||Receipt.OperationCount!=62){Report.AddFatal(TEXT("isolated_save_required_field_invalid"),TEXT("Committed state, receipt, scenario, and 62-operation coverage are required."));return false;}

bool FMWNorwayScenarioTranslator::LoadIsolatedSaveSnapshot(const FMWNorwayIsolatedSaveSnapshot& Snapshot,FMWNorwayIsolatedCommitState& State,FMWNorwayIsolatedCommitReceipt& Receipt,FMWNorwayIsolatedSaveLoadReport& Report)

if(Snapshot.SnapshotId!=TEXT("Norway.IsolatedSaveSnapshot.1062Opening")||Snapshot.ScenarioId!=TEXT("Scenario.Norway.1062Opening")||Snapshot.StateFingerprint.IsEmpty()||Snapshot.ReceiptFingerprint.IsEmpty()){Report.AddFatal(TEXT("isolated_load_identity_invalid"),TEXT("Snapshot identity, scenario, or required fingerprints are invalid."));return false;}

if(StateFp!=Snapshot.StateFingerprint||ReceiptFp!=Snapshot.ReceiptFingerprint){State=FMWNorwayIsolatedCommitState();Receipt=FMWNorwayIsolatedCommitReceipt();Report.AddFatal(TEXT("isolated_load_fingerprint_mismatch"),TEXT("Snapshot state or receipt fingerprint is corrupt."));return false;}

if(Source.bAdvancedSave){Report.bAdvancedSaveRejected=true;Report.AddFatal(TEXT("isolated_migration_advanced_save_rejected"),TEXT("Advanced save migration is prohibited for Opening State."));return false;}
